acceptance_evidence: CCA verdict and MergeGate evidence are recorded before completion.

the guardian-comment parser ignores stale/malformed approval comments once a valid exact-head approval exists, without weakening genuine-stale protection
mergegate records reviewer_type=external_ai_model; shiki_loop merges high/critical when the MergeGate policy gate is green; ADR 0010 + docs + CONTEXT.md authority glossary recorded
all contract tests + unittests green incl. AI-approval and poisoning-coexistence fixtures

outcome: An external AI reviewer can authorize autonomous merge of high/critical PRs via a head-SHA-bound external_ai_guardian_review artifact, recorded under the AI reviewer's own identity (reviewer_type=external_ai_model) and never as operator approval; the guardian-comment poisoning bug is fixed; the goal loop merges high/critical when the MergeGate policy gate is green
title: Authority-in-the-loop: external AI guardian review as a first-class approval source (ADR 0010)
